calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.format,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN frl.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN frl.refund_net ELSE 0 END) as returns_net,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN frl.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN frl.sales_line_id END) as returned_line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as total_line_count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

SELECT 
  ds.format,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN frl.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN frl.refund_net ELSE 0 END) 
        / SUM(fsl.net_amount), 2) as return_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format
